_comment: Painted character art (milestones 5B-5D). Any creator gets painted art when a manifest exists at defaults.manifest (with {id} = creator id), generated by art_pipeline/extract_sheets.py; 'creators' only holds per-creator overrides. What the paintings depict comes from the creator's own template: her template look (hair colour, hairstyle, bust, body, lips) and natural body are the painted ones. 'adapts' lists look slots the renderer can change on the paintings (hair_color: masked recolour shader); other differences (hairstyles, procedures, unpainted outfits, tattoos) are listed as 'not painted yet' while the painting stays. 'outfits' maps game outfit ids to painted outfits; 'full_body' is the hero image per painted outfit; 'sprites' maps house animations to painted poses per painted outfit ('*' = any; lying anims need an explicit pose); 'expressions' maps CreatorMood moods to painted busts. Rigs (Skeleton2D) come from defaults.rigs.

defaults._house_scale_comment: Painted sprites are drawn this much larger in the house (the procedural sprites also get a larger head there) so faces stay readable at ~120 px.

ava._comment: Ava's casual hero image is the master sheet.
